description: The royal court of King Virata. The Pandavas live here in disguise during their 13th year of exile. Yudhishthira as a courtier, Bhima as a cook, Arjuna as Brihannala the eunuch dancer. Modest, provincial.

vn_backdrop_notes.lighting: Natural daylight, open air pavilion style.
vn_backdrop_notes.mood: Provincial simplicity, less grand than Hastinapura.
